subject: Kubernetes pod crash loop in production

thread.body:
Our pods keep crashing. Here is the log:

[2024-06-04T14:00:01Z] ERROR: Failed to bind to port 8080
[2024-06-04T14:00:01Z] FATAL: Address already in use
[2024-06-04T14:00:02Z] Process exited with code 1
[2024-06-04T14:00:05Z] Restarting container (attempt 1/5)
[2024-06-04T14:00:08Z] ERROR: Failed to bind to port 8080
[2024-06-04T14:00:08Z] FATAL: Address already in use
Two pods are trying to bind to the same hostPort 8080. The DaemonSet was accidentally deployed alongside a Deployment that also uses hostPort. Need to remove hostPort from the Deployment spec.
Root cause identified: a Deployment was using hostPort 8080 which conflicts with the existing DaemonSet. Removed the hostPort configuration from the Deployment. Pods are now stable.
